title: Dream landscape
content: My dreams include a mall but also a resort/beach,convenient stores,houses with infinite rooms and all my family; dead and alive. I can never find what I'm looking for at the mall. When I'm at the resort I'm packing endless amounts of crap. The bathrooms are always disgusting.Then when I leave,my car has been stolen and no phones work for help. I've had these dreams everyday for at least 3 years. I'm was also in the Gate program.
